name: Where the Winter Snow Waits
source:
You travel alone through a ice-cold snowy mountain where every foot-step disappears behind you, until you spot a familiar figure.

Decide what you do when you are forced to be reminded of someone you love.

[From [url=https://drowningfizh.itch.io/wherethewintersnowwaits]itch.io[/url]]
